title: Intrinsic constant-ring modules and fixed-module sheaves
statement: For any scheme T and commutative ring B, restrict a sheaf of modules over the constant ring sheaf B_T on T_proet to the constant scalars using the sheafification unit. The resulting functor to sheaves valued in modules over ULift B is an equivalence. Its underlying additive sheaf is unchanged. The intrinsic category and constant module constructions are those of [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf] and [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. No finiteness, nonzero-ring or nonempty-scheme assumption is required.

proof.text: Construct restriction on each module of sections using the canonical constant-section map. Its underlying additive sections and restriction maps are unchanged.

Embed fixed-module-valued presheaves fully faithfully into presheaves of modules over the constant ring presheaf. Module sheafification along the locally bijective constant-section map is adjoint to restriction. The right adjoint is fully faithful by the module-sheafification theorem (Mathlib PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction and its fully faithful restriction).

For a fixed-module-valued sheaf, its module sheafification unit is already invertible: forgetting to abelian presheaves gives sheafification of an existing sheaf. Reflect invertibility through the fully faithful embedding to obtain essential surjectivity. Take the equivalence of this fully faithful essentially surjective functor.
